Busy all week, but where is the profit?

Many cleaning owners price by copying competitors or national averages. Then payroll taxes, drive time, card fees and insurance quietly eat the margin. A 30% markup is only a 23% margin — before overhead.

  • See the full cost of every job before you quote it
  • Price for the margin you actually want, with discounts that do not eat it
  • Catch prices that lose money — with a red warning, not a surprise at tax time

Questions

Does it work in Google Sheets?

Yes. Upload the .xlsx file to Google Drive and choose File > Save as Google Sheets. All formulas, drop-downs and charts work. Sheet protection is not imported, so the grey formula cells are not locked in Google Sheets.

Which Excel versions are supported?

Excel 2019, 2021 and Microsoft 365 (Windows and Mac) and the free Excel for the web. There are no macros. Excel 2016 and older lack two functions used by the Clients sheet.

Is this a subscription?

No. You pay once and keep the files. There is nothing to log in to.

Will it tell me what to charge in my city?

No tool can know your local market. TidyMargin calculates the price your own costs and target margin require. The default rates are examples that you replace with your own numbers. Compare the result with your local market and decide.

Where is my data stored?

In your own file, on your computer or in your own Google or Microsoft account. We never see it.

Can I use it on my phone?

Yes, in the Excel or Google Sheets app. Setting it up is easier on a computer.

Does the invoice collect payments?

No. It is a professional document you send. Your clients pay you the way you already accept payments.

Is this tax or accounting advice?

No. It is a business-management tool that estimates profit. Talk to a tax professional about taxes.

What if it does not work for me?

Contact us and we will help. If we cannot fix a problem with the files, see our refund policy.
